Verified domain benchmarkspacesystems.com (Burlington, VT; green/HTP and electric in-space propulsion). Series A (company called it 'major Series A funding' in April 2022) = Oct 2021 Form D: $8,277,141 offering, $7,435,616 sold, including conversion of outstanding indebtedness; $33M Series B (Aug 2023) led by SP Catamount with JH Capital, The Fund at Hula, FreshTracks; June 2025 round (company said it closed a new round alongside CEO transition) - Form D shows $2,402,041 sold, stage unnamed. Total $42.84M = sum of SEC/press-sourced amounts. A May 2026 Form D shows a $10M offering with $0 sold at filing (not counted). Has AFRL contracts (contracts, not grants; not itemized).
